emily: Heads-up — Velora (VL-621) reached out. CFO says they're in acquisition talks and asked us to place INV-2026-0788 ($37,200, due 2026-04-20) into escrow for 45 days while the buyer validates contracts. They want no late fees and no service interruption.

harsh: Any payment attempts or failures?

emily: One retry attempted 2026-04-22 (card_decline). Ledger: invoice INV-2026-0788, amount 37200.00, due 2026-04-20, status unpaid, attempts:1.

priya: Legal: escrow requests are unusual. We can consider a short escrow hold if buyer is a verified entity and we get a signed escrow agreement + buyer ACH on file. Also need indemnity language.

marcus: Risk: account has two prior late notices 18 months ago but current usage is stable. I'm open to a 45-day escrow hold conditional on buyer contact + funds held in escrow. If buyer fails to fund, we revert to collections.

billing-bot: ALERT: VL-621 flagged - PAYMENT_ACTION_REQUIRED (INV-2026-0788). Next automated retry scheduled 2026-04-29.

emily: Proposed steps: 1) Ask customer for buyer contact + proof of funds. 2) Prepare a short escrow agreement (billing+legal). 3) If buyer executes and funds escrow, waive late fees for the 45d hold. 4) Service remains active while escrow is funded. Anyone object?

priya: Add clause: waiver void if buyer revokes or escrow isn't fully funded within 7 business days of agreement signature. Need legal to draft quick addendum.

marcus: Also require a backup payment method from Velora and auto-collect enabled for remainder after escrow closes. If buyer doesn't fund, charge full amount + late fees and open collections.

legal: We'll draft an "escrow-hold-addendum-v1" with indemnity and funding timelines. Will need buyer entity info and a signed statement.

emily: I'll request buyer contact and sample PO from CS. Draft message to customer: 

"Hi Velora — we can consider a short escrow hold for INV-2026-0788 conditional on (1) buyer contact and PO, (2) signed escrow addendum, and (3) buyer funds deposited to escrow within 7 business days of signature. If escrow is funded we will waive late fees and keep service active for 45 days. If funding fails we will reapply fees and resume collections. Please provide buyer contact and confirm if they can fund escrow. — Emily (Billing)"
